alreadyOpen.title: Orchester is already open
alreadyOpen.description: Another Orchester window is using this data folder. One Orchester opens a data folder at a time, so its projects, runners and agents never run twice.
alreadyOpen.footnote: Switching brings that window to the front and closes this one.
alreadyOpen.unsupported: Switching to that window isn't available on this system yet. Bring it to the front yourself, then close this one.
alreadyOpen.unknownProcess: Orchester can't tell which process has the data folder open, so it can't switch to it. Close this window, then find the other one.

closing.title: Orchester is closing
closing.description: The other Orchester window has closed and still has this data folder while its agents save. Start Orchester again in a few seconds.

noAnswer.title: That window didn't come to the front
noAnswer.description: It may be busy or stuck. This window still doesn't open the data folder.
noAnswer.stepBody: If it stays stuck, end process {{pid}} in Task Manager, then start Orchester again. Its agents stop with it, and their runs are offered for continuing on the next start.

newerData.title: Orchester can't open its data
newerData.reason: The database was written by a newer version of Orchester.
newerData.description: It has data version {{found}}; this build reads up to version {{supported}}. Nothing was changed.
newerData.step: Start the newer Orchester that wrote this data, or install it over this one. This build leaves the file as it is: opening it could damage data it doesn't know.

unreadable.title: Orchester can't read its data
unreadable.reason: The database file is damaged or isn't Orchester's: “{{reason}}”.
unreadable.reasonRefused: The database could not be opened: “{{reason}}”.
unreadable.step: Restore the file from a backup if you have one. Moving it out of the folder lets Orchester start with an empty project list: each project keeps its tasks and runs in its own .orchester folder.
unreadable.stepRefused: Close any other program that has the file open, check that your account can read and write it, then start Orchester again.

updateFailed.title: Orchester couldn't update its data
updateFailed.reason: Updating the database to this version would leave {{count}} broken references, so it was left unchanged.
updateFailed.description: It has data version {{found}}; this build needs version {{supported}}.
updateFailed.step: Start the previous Orchester version to keep working with this data, and report the problem with the log.

notWritable.title: Orchester can't write to its data folder
notWritable.besideProgram: Orchester keeps its data beside its program, and your account can't write to this folder.
notWritable.elsewhere: Orchester keeps its data in this folder, and your account can't write to it.
notWritable.stepBesideProgram: Install Orchester in a folder your account can write to, or give your account write access to this one.
notWritable.stepElsewhere: Check that your account owns this folder and can write to it, then start Orchester again.

programFolder.title: Orchester can't find its own folder
programFolder.reason: The folder of the Orchester program could not be determined.
programFolder.description: Orchester keeps its data and its runner beside its program, so it can't open them. The log has the system's reason.
programFolder.step: Start Orchester from its install folder, or install it again.

agentCli.title: {{program}} isn't found on this computer
agentCli.bodyLoginShell: Apps started from Finder don't get your terminal's PATH. Orchester read it from your login shell ({{shell}}) and still can't find {{program}}. Local projects open; agents can't start until it's found.
agentCli.bodyUsualFolders: Orchester looked on your PATH and in the usual install folders and can't find {{program}}. Local projects open; agents can't start until it's found.
agentCli.bodyPath: Orchester looked in the folders on your PATH and can't find {{program}}. Local projects open; agents can't start until it's found.
agentCli.noFolders: There are no folders on PATH to look in.

start.title: How do you want to start?
start.lead: Orchester gives your tasks to coding agents, each in its own worktree, and brings the result back for you to review.

folder.title: Add a project from a folder
folder.body: Pick a git repository on this computer. Orchester keeps the project's tasks, agents and settings next to it.
folder.chooseTitle: Choose the folder of a git repository

join.title: Join a team
join.body: Sign in with Orchester Cloud to see your teams, or enter a pairing code a teammate gives you.
join.bodySignedIn: Pick one of your teams, or enter a pairing code a teammate gives you.

shared.title: Open a team's shared project
shared.body: Have an invite or a project address? Pick the project and link it to a folder; you join its team on the way.
shared.meta: Needs a team · join on the way

joined.one: {{team}} shares 1 project with you. Pick it and link it to a folder; its tasks download here.
joined.other: {{team}} shares {{count}} projects with you. Pick one and link it to a folder; its tasks download here.
joined.none: {{team}} shares no project with you yet. Once one invites you, pick it here and link it to a folder.
joined.unknown: Pick one of {{team}}'s projects and link it to a folder; its tasks download here.

start.local: No account is needed to work on this computer. Orchester Cloud is only for team features.
start.localSignedIn: Signed in as {{email}}. Local projects never need the account.
start.footer: Projects, tasks, runs and worktrees stay on this computer. A team server keeps only a shared project's tasks and settings.

join.title: Join a team
join.lead: Two ways in. Either one gives this computer its own sign-in on the team server; nothing local is uploaded.
join.note: Orchester Cloud is only for team features. Without it, local projects work as before.

cloud.title: With Orchester Cloud
cloud.sub: Lists every team and invite of your account

code.title: With a code
code.sub: For a team server without the internet, or without Cloud
code.label: Code
code.hint: An invite code from a teammate, or a pairing code from your other computer. 8 characters, works once.
code.wrong: Wrong or expired. A code works once, within 10 minutes: ask for a new one.

unreachable.title: Can't reach {{host}}
unreachable.body: No answer in {{seconds}} seconds. Check the address and your network, or ask the team's owner if the server is running.

settings.title: {{server}} needs a check first
settings.body: Its certificate or plain HTTP needs your check. Join it in Settings › Orchester › Connect a server.

teams.title: Choose a team
teams.lead: The team servers and invites of your Orchester Cloud account. Joining gives this computer its own sign-in there.
teams.none: No team servers in your account yet.
teams.notListed: A team not listed? Ask its owner to invite {{email}}, or join with a code.

joined.title: Joined {{server}} as {{username}}
joined.body: This computer has its own sign-in there now.

waiting.title: Waiting for approval
waiting.body: {{server}} asks for approval of new computers. Approve this one on another computer of yours, or ask an admin. Nothing has been uploaded.

notInvited.title: {{server}} has no place for {{email}}
notInvited.body: Ask its owner to invite this email, or join with a code.

download.lead: {{project}} is linked to {{folder}}. Its tasks and team settings come from {{address}}.

joined.title: Joined {{server}}
joined.sub: {{address}} · this computer has its own sign-in
joined.signedOutSub: {{address}} · this computer has no sign-in there
joined.noServerTitle: Its team server is no longer in the list
joined.noServerSub: Add the server again in Settings › Orchester.

linked.title: Linked to {{folder}}
linked.noHint: origin {{origin}} · the project names no repository

tasks.idleSub: Nothing is downloading now. They stay up to date with {{server}}.

settings.title: Team settings
settings.pending: Pipelines, agent profiles, instructions, skills and tools · after the tasks
settings.done: Pipelines, agent profiles, instructions, skills and tools · downloaded
settings.notAvailable: Pipelines, agent profiles, instructions, skills and tools · not downloaded yet

canOpen.title: You can open {{project}} now
canOpen.body: Tasks keep arriving in the list as they download. No restart is needed.

notShared.title: {{project}} isn't linked to a team
notShared.lead: Nothing is downloading for it. Link it in its Project settings › Sharing.

missing.title: This project is no longer on this computer
missing.lead: Add its folder again from All projects.

download.unread: This project could not be read

shared.readFailed: The team's projects could not be read
shared.signedIn: This computer has its own sign-in there now.

projects.title: Pick a project from {{team}}
projects.lead: Only the projects you are invited to are listed. Each one keeps its tasks and team settings on {{address}}.

none.title: No projects for you on {{team}} yet
none.body: You joined {{address}}, but no project there has invited {{who}}. Ask an owner to invite you: the project then shows here and in All projects.

link.titlePending: Link a project to a folder
link.title: Link {{project}} to a folder
link.lead: Orchester works in a checkout on this computer. The team server never touches code: use a checkout you have, or clone it here.
link.leadNoClone: Orchester works in a checkout on this computer. The team server never touches code: use a checkout you have.

existing.title: Use a checkout I have
existing.sub: A folder with the repository already cloned

link.chooseTitle: Choose the folder of your checkout
link.matches: Git repository · origin {{origin}} matches the project
link.notRepository: Not a git repository. Pick the folder you cloned, or clone it below.
link.notRepositoryNoClone: Not a git repository. Pick the folder you cloned.

differs.title: origin is {{origin}}
differs.body: {{project}} expects {{hint}}. Link anyway if this is your fork; runs push to its origin.

clone.title: No checkout yet? Clone it here
clone.sub: Git clones {{hint}} in a console window, where you can sign in if it asks. Orchester picks the new folder above when Git finishes.
clone.intoPlaceholder: The new folder for the checkout
clone.emptyFolder: An empty folder: Git clones into it
clone.occupied: This folder already has files. Choose an empty folder or a new name: Orchester never clones over files.
clone.notAbsolute: Give the folder's full path, from its drive or from /, or choose where to put it.
clone.notLocal: Choose a folder on this computer: Orchester doesn't clone onto a network share.
clone.unreadable: This folder can't be read. Choose another one.

waiting.title: Git is cloning in a console window
waiting.body: Sign in there if Git asks. Closing the window stops the clone.

clone.done: Cloned into {{path}}. It's chosen above: link it with the button below.

gitMissing.title: Git isn't installed
gitMissing.body: Install Git from git-scm.com (on a Mac, the command line tools), then clone again.

notOpened.title: The console window didn't open
notOpened.body: Nothing was cloned. Try again, or clone in a terminal of your own and choose the folder above.

notStarted.title: Terminal didn't start the clone
notStarted.body: Nothing was cloned. Check that Terminal may run scripts from Orchester, then try again.

unsupported.title: Cloning in a console isn't available on this system yet
unsupported.body: Clone in a terminal of your own, then choose the folder above.

lost.title: Orchester lost track of the clone
lost.body: Look at the console window: when Git has finished, choose the new folder above.

failed.title: Git stopped before the clone finished (code {{code}})
failed.body: Git's message is in the console window. If it says access was denied, sign in when Git asks, or check that your account can read {{hint}}, then try again.

closed.title: The console closed before the clone finished

notCheckout.title: Git finished, but the folder isn't a checkout of this project

clone.left: Git left the folder {{path}}. Orchester didn't remove it: delete it yourself, or choose another folder.

console.title: Orchester · cloning {{project}}
console.failed: Git did not finish the clone; its message is above.
console.close: Press Enter to close this window
